title: Recovery of the input from a row
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, and let $x,y$ be Boolean lists each of length $n$. For any configurations $c,d$ of $M$ on those respective inputs, if the input fields of their codec rows are equal, then $x=y$.
hypotheses_covered: Proofs that $x$ and $y$ each have length $n$
A configuration $c$ on input $x$ and a configuration $d$ on input $y$
Equality of the input fields of their codec rows
